content: Melvin-Koushki states that the Munāẓara-yi Bazm u Razm was 'completed before 25 Rabīʿ II 829/6 March 1426 in Herat', with an asterisk, citing Āqā Buzurg; the five-day gap from the 20 Rabīʿ II copy date on the previous page is not explained.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Munāẓara-yi Bazm u Razm
